Supported CSV format:
- Encoding: UTF-8; delimiter: comma (,)
- Header row (recommended; column order is flexible, extra columns are ignored):
 %1$s
- For leave records, fill in: 请假(是/否), 请假类型(年假/病假/…), 请假天数
- 加班类型/加班费 are display-only columns and are ignored on import (overtime pay is calculated from your salary settings)
- Legacy export headers are supported, e.g. 加班时长(小时), 加班费(元)
- Headerless files are supported (column order: 日期,上班时间,下班时间,加班时长,额外时长,备注)

Example (Chinese column names are required for import):
日期,上班时间,下班时间,加班时长,加班类型,加班费,额外时长,请假,请假类型,请假天数,备注
2024-01-01,09:00,18:00,1.5,平时,28.74,0.0,否,无,0.0,元旦加班
2024-01-02,无,无,0.0,平时,0.00,0.0,是,年假,8.0,休年假

Supported date formats:
- yyyy-MM-dd (recommended)
- yyyy/MM/dd
- yyyy年MM月dd日
- yyyyMMdd
